import math
pts=[]
X=Y=A=0.0
last=None
report=-1
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,last,pts,report
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; st=math.radians(o['steer_deg'])
 w=v*math.tan(st)/2.5
 mid=A+w*dt/2
 X+=v*math.cos(mid)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(mid)*dt; A+=w*dt
 ca=math.cos(A); sa=math.sin(A)
 for name,side in [('left_mirror',1),('right_mirror',-1)]:
  view=o['views'].get(name)
  if view:
   ox,oy=view['origin']
   for b,d in view['walls']:
    b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
    if x < -1 and d<23:
     pts.append((X+ca*x-sa*y,Y+sa*x+ca*y,side,t))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[3]<28]
 if len(pts)>3500: pts=pts[::2]
 local=[]
 for px,py,s,tt in pts:
  dx=px-X; dy=py-Y
  local.append((ca*dx+sa*dy,-sa*dx+ca*dy,s,tt))
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=o['hitch_deg']
 tx=rx-5*math.cos(math.radians(h))
 vals=[]
 for side in [1,-1]:
  pp=[p for p in local if p[2]==side and abs(p[0]-tx)<3]
  if pp:
   weights=[math.exp(-((p[0]-tx)/1.5)**2)*math.exp(-(t-p[3])/15) for p in pp]
   vals.append(sum(p[1]*ww for p,ww in zip(pp,weights))/sum(weights))
 if len(vals)==2:
  ty=sum(vals)/2
  err=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-ry,rx-tx))
  desired=max(-23,min(23,h+0.8*(err-h)))
 else: desired=0
 eq=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(math.radians(h))/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(math.radians(h)))))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,eq+2.2*(h-desired)))
 speed=-0.8
 if abs(h)>30: speed=-0.35
 look=64.3 if int((t-12)/2.3)%2==0 else -64.3
 if int(t/5)!=report:
  report=int(t/5); print('TRACK',round(t,1),'h',round(h,1),'rails',[round(z,2) for z in vals],'aim',round(desired,1),'steer',round(steer,1))
 return steer,speed,look

X=Y=A=0.0

lastprint=-1
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,pts,lastprint
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; w=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5
 X+=v*math.cos(A+w*dt/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+w*dt/2)*dt; A+=w*dt
 c=math.cos(A); s=math.sin(A)
 for name,side in [('left_mirror',1),('right_mirror',-1)]:
  view=o['views'].get(name)
  if view:
   ox,oy=view['origin']
   for b,d in view['walls']:
    b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
    if -17<x<-2 and d<19 and side*(y-oy)>-0.2:
     pts.append((X+c*x-s*y,Y+s*x+c*y,side,t))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[3]<45]
 if len(pts)>1800: pts=pts[::2]
 loc=[]
 for px,py,side,tt in pts:
  dx=px-X; dy=py-Y
  loc.append((c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy,side,tt))
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; tx=rx-3.5
 rails=[]
 for side in [1,-1]:
  pp=[p for p in loc if p[2]==side and abs(p[0]-tx)<5]
  if len(pp)>=2:
   ww=[math.exp(-((p[0]-tx)/2.8)**2)*math.exp(-(t-p[3])/18) for p in pp]

   den=sum(z*(p[0]-mx)**2 for p,z in zip(pp,ww))
   slope=sum(z*(p[0]-mx)*(p[1]-my) for p,z in zip(pp,ww))/max(.05,den)
   slope=max(-1,min(1,slope))
   rails.append(my+slope*(tx-mx))
 h=o['hitch_deg']
 if len(rails)==2:
  ty=sum(rails)/2
  desired=max(-26,min(26,math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-ry,rx-tx))))
 else: desired=h
 eq=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(math.radians(h))/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(math.radians(h)))))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,eq+2.6*(h-desired)))

 if int(t/3)!=lastprint:
  lastprint=int(t/3); print('TRACK',round(t,1),'h',round(h,1),'rails',[round(z,2) for z in rails],'aim',round(desired,1))
 return steer,-0.5,look

import math
X=Y=A=0.0
last=-1
def control(o):
 global X,Y,A,last
 dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; w=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5
 X+=v*math.cos(A+w*dt/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+w*dt/2)*dt; A+=w*dt
 c=math.cos(A); s=math.sin(A)
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
 gx=X+c*rx-s*ry; gy=Y+s*rx+c*ry
 # Follow the centre between the surveyed rails, looking three metres back.
 ax=gx-3.0; ay=-0.52*ax-1.2
 dx=ax-gx; dy=ay-gy
 backx=-(c*dx+s*dy); left=-s*dx+c*dy
 desired=max(-30,min(32,math.degrees(math.atan2(left,max(1,backx)))))
 h=o['hitch_deg']
 eq=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(math.radians(h))/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(math.radians(h)))))
 steer=max(-43,min(43,eq+2.7*(h-desired)))
 look=64.3 if int((o['t']-120.7)/2.8)%2==0 else -64.3
 if int(o['t']/2)!=last:
  last=int(o['t']/2)
  print('TRACK',round(X,2),round(Y,2),round(math.degrees(A),1),'h',round(h,1),'aim',round(desired,1))
  for name in ['left_mirror','right_mirror']:
   view=o['views'].get(name)
   if view:
    ox,oy=view['origin']; points=[]
    for b,d in view['walls']:
     a=math.radians(b); xx=ox+d*math.cos(a); yy=oy+d*math.sin(a)
     if -13<xx<-3: points.append((round(xx,1),round(yy,1)))
    print(name,points,'BAY',view.get('target_corners',[]))
 return steer,-0.35,look

 global X,Y,A,last
 dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; w=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5
 X+=v*math.cos(A+w*dt/2)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(A+w*dt/2)*dt; A+=w*dt

 along=(gx-p0[0])*u[0]+(gy-p0[1])*u[1]

 h=o['hitch_deg']

 a[2][2]+=2

 global distance,done

 if distance>=1.0 and not done:

 return (max(-15,min(25,steer)),0 if done else -0.15,-41)
